# ETH Swap

> ETH Swap is a non-custodial web interface for swapping ETH for USDC, USDT and other ERC-20 tokens on Ethereum. Users connect their own wallet, review a DEX-routed quote with price impact and slippage, and sign every transaction themselves.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- ETH Swap covers ETH, USDC, USDT and any ERC-20 token on Ethereum mainnet.
- Gas on Ethereum is always paid in ETH, including for token approvals.
- ERC-20 tokens need a one-time approval before swapping; native ETH does not.
- Quotes come from on-chain DEX routing and show price impact and a slippage tolerance.
- The interface is non-custodial: it never holds funds or keys and the user signs every transaction.

## Pages

- ETH Swap & learn: https://swap-eth.github.io/
- Legal: https://swap-eth.github.io/legal.html
